event.description:
Another Wednesday in the Archive!

Join us at Hobby Lookout for Grand Archive Weekly Play.

Format: Standard Constructed
Rounds: 3 Swiss Rounds
Match Format: Best of 1

Weekly Play starts at 7:30 PM.

New to Grand Archive? We also run a FREE Learn to Play session from 5:00 PM–7:00 PM before Weekly Play.

Entry: BND 10
Includes: 1 Booster Pack
Prizes: 1 Black Event Pack per win

See you in the Archive!
